## PRB1.4. Environment

-   Slovakia registered a KEA performance of 4.27%. Their target of 4.01% was not achieved and Slovakia did not contribute positively to Union-wide performance. The NSA states the main reason for not meeting the target is that performance was affected by the continued closure of Ukrainian airspace, which required traffic rerouting and resulted in longer trajectories.

-   Both KEP and KES deteriorated in comparison with 2024.

-   VFE of the actual en route trajectory was at 77.57%, which was better than the average Union-wide performance.

-   No airports are included in the performance plan for monitoring.
